# LeadKart CRM — Multi-Tenant B2B Sales Platform

> LeadKart CRM (Zenith CRM) is an enterprise-grade multi-tenant B2B Sales CRM and pipeline automation suite designed for growing sales teams, agencies, and revenue operations.

## Key Capabilities
- **Lead Capture & Management**: Qualify, score, tag, and assign incoming leads across custom stages and sources.
- **Visual Sales Pipeline**: Real-time Kanban board with database-calculated weighted deal values and probability forecasts.
- **Follow-Up Automation**: Task management for sales calls, emails, demos, and meetings with overdue alerts and automated activity feeds.
- **Quotations & Invoicing**: Integrated quotation builder, itemized line items, automatic tax/discount formulas, conversion to invoices, and balance tracking.
- **Product Catalog Management**: Products and service inventory with SKUs, category tags, and line-item linking.
- **Multi-Tenant Security & RBAC**: Strict Row Level Security (RLS) in PostgreSQL isolating tenant data across organizations, with granular roles (Owner, Admin, Sales Manager, Executive).

## Primary Routes & Applications
- [Landing Page](https://leadkart.lovable.app/): Product summary and workspace access.
- [Authentication & Demo](https://leadkart.lovable.app/auth): Secure login, team signup, and instant seeded sandbox workspace access.
- [Sales Dashboard](https://leadkart.lovable.app/dashboard): Live revenue metrics, open leads, weighted pipeline, and activities timeline.
- [Leads Directory](https://leadkart.lovable.app/leads): Interactive lead management with drawer activity feeds.
- [Kanban Pipeline](https://leadkart.lovable.app/pipeline): Drag-and-drop opportunity pipeline management.
- [Task & Follow-Ups](https://leadkart.lovable.app/follow-ups): Sales tasks and schedule calendar.
- [Quotations Generator](https://leadkart.lovable.app/quotations): B2B quotation builder.
- [Invoices & Payments](https://leadkart.lovable.app/invoices): Billing tracking and payment reconciliation.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: TanStack Start, TanStack Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI primitives.
- **Backend & Database**: Supabase PostgreSQL with strict RLS policies and server-side RPC functions.
- **State & Data Sync**: TanStack Query v5 with optimistic UI updates and real-time invalidation.

## Optional Documentation
- [Full LLM Specification](https://leadkart.lovable.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive API models, DB schemas, and workspace configuration guide.
